'''F'ej D'aw''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] henchman. He once worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Nawnam]] and was at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Nawman's last henchman.<ref name="HL" />
